message.content:
**Allele Frequency of rs7412 (APOE ε2) in Europeans**

| Population | Allele Frequency (C allele) |
|------------|-----------------------------|
| European (overall) | **~0.13–0.15** |

*Sources:*  
- 1000 Genomes Project Phase 3 – European (EUR) dataset shows the C allele frequency at ~0.14.  
- GWAS Catalog and dbSNP reports consistent frequencies around 12–15 % in European cohorts.

So, roughly **13–15 %** of alleles at rs7412 in European populations carry the C variant.
